title: $1,000 in Apple's first trading day is now worth this
caption:
Apple started trading in 1980.
$1,000 at the first day's closing price would be worth about {growth:AAPL:1980-12-12} today (share price only, no dividends).
comment: Which company would you go back in time to buy? 👇
sources: Apple share price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 1980, Apple sold its first shares to the public.

clip.text: Apple lists on the stock market

scenes.say: Imagine putting in one thousand dollars on day one.
Today, that would be worth about {growth:AAPL:1980-12-12}.
